title: Victor B Possible NDE 7914
content: When I was four, I had a very serious surgery. One night my left kidney stopped working. I lost consciousness immediately and was transported to a hospital by ambulance. My kidney was removed. I had no recollection of the event for more than 30 years. Since my childhood, I had a recurring dream, in which I was getting more and more farther from the world. I felt like I was a powerful magnet, which repels the whole world from itself. It is hard to describe with words. I had this dream at least a thousand times during the years. When I was 35, I started visiting a psychologist, mainly because I only had a few memories from my childhood (before I was 12 years old). I wanted to know the reason of this. During the sessions, more and more childhood memories surfaced. Bad and good ones as well. One time, with the help of the KIP method I was brought back at the time when I was four, and then I was lying on the operating table and the well-known scene from my dreams started happening and I was moving away from the world. I saw myself lying on table. I also saw that the doctors started to rush. I drifted further and further away from everything. After the first fright, it wasn’t a dreadful experience at all. Finally, I have arrived to a bright, white place. It looked as if I was in clouds. There was silence, peace and it seemed like time ceased to exist. I don’t know how much time I spend here, but after a while, I started to fall back, towards my body. Like a very strong magnet pulled me back. I tried to resist, I didn’t want to return, but the force was stronger than I was.
